selection: Editorial selection of established model families and influential research milestones; not an exhaustive catalog, popularity ranking or lineage graph. Minor variants are omitted unless they add a distinct architectural or historical contrast.

releases.name: Transformer
releases.caveat: Architecture anchor, not a released LLM checkpoint.

releases.name: GPT
releases.locator: Publication date and opening release announcement
releases.caveat: Original GPT, not a later GPT family variant.

releases.name: BERT
releases.caveat: Paper date, not the subsequent code release.

releases.name: GPT-2
releases.caveat: Initial announcement and smaller model release, not the later full 1.5B weights release.

releases.name: T5
releases.caveat: The first preprint is from 2019; the JMLR publication is from 2020.

releases.name: GPT-3
releases.caveat: Paper date, not the June API beta launch.

releases.name: CLIP
releases.caveat: Contrastive image and text encoders, not a conversational generative VLM.

releases.name: Switch Transformer
releases.caveat: Research milestone; not a commercial service launch.

releases.name: GLM
releases.caveat: Early GLM framework; not the later GLM-4 or GLM-5 release.
releases.selection_basis: Established bilingual language model family and distinct pretraining research.

releases.name: InstructGPT
releases.locator: Publication date, Methods and footnotes A and B
releases.caveat: Public alignment announcement and API default update; earlier beta variants had already been deployed.

releases.name: Chinchilla
releases.caveat: Compute allocation study, not a public weights release.

releases.name: PaLM
releases.caveat: The recorded event is the first preprint, not a claim about the first announcement.

releases.name: Flamingo
releases.caveat: Research model, not the later independent OpenFlamingo project.

releases.name: BLOOM
releases.locator: Publication date and paragraphs announcing downloadable weights
releases.caveat: Weights release, not the November 9 technical preprint. No unrestricted open source classification is implied.

releases.name: ChatGPT
releases.locator: Publication date and research preview introduction
releases.caveat: Product and dialogue model milestone; not a new architecture specification.

releases.name: BLIP-2
releases.caveat: Paper date; no claim that all checkpoints were released that day.

releases.name: LLaMA
releases.caveat: The recorded event is the first preprint. Original capitalization distinguishes the first family.

releases.name: GPT-4
releases.locator: Publication date and initial availability paragraph
releases.caveat: Image inputs were a research preview, not broadly available at launch.

releases.name: ChatGLM-6B
releases.locator: Section 1, March 14 release paragraph and Table 1
releases.caveat: The report was published in 2024; it explicitly dates the 6B release in 2023.
releases.selection_basis: Early locally deployable bilingual chat model; its retrospective report documents substantial community use.

releases.name: LLaVA
releases.caveat: Original LLaVA study, not every later LLaVA variant.

releases.name: Llama 2
releases.locator: July 18 date and opening availability statement
releases.caveat: A selected generation; not every Llama checkpoint is listed.
releases.selection_basis: Major early public family release, with partner distribution documented at launch.

releases.name: Mistral 7B
releases.caveat: Initial 7B release; later versions are not separate entries here.

releases.name: Mamba
releases.caveat: Selective state space model, not a Transformer or necessarily a chat product.
releases.selection_basis: Recognizable alternative sequence modeling architecture; complements the existing architecture collection.

releases.name: Gemini 1.0
releases.locator: Publication date, Gemini 1.0 introduction and availability
releases.caveat: Ultra, Pro and Nano did not all have identical launch availability.

releases.name: Mixtral 8x7B
releases.locator: Publication date and model release announcement
releases.caveat: Dated release article, not a claim about the first distribution of weights.

releases.name: InternVL
releases.caveat: Original InternVL paper, not its later chat and reasoning versions.
releases.selection_basis: Established VLM family; fills a multimodal rather than another chat-model gap.

releases.name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
releases.locator: February 15 date and limited preview paragraphs
releases.caveat: Limited preview; not universal availability of all Gemini 1.5 variants.
releases.selection_basis: Distinct long context generation in an established multimodal family.

releases.name: Claude 3
releases.caveat: Opus and Sonnet were available; Haiku followed later.

releases.name: DeepSeek-V2
releases.caveat: Paper date, not an inferred first API or weights date.
releases.selection_basis: Provides the architectural precursor to the already selected V3 and R1 milestones.

releases.name: GPT-4o
releases.caveat: Announced multimodal capabilities did not all become generally available on the same day.

releases.name: Llama 3.1
releases.locator: Publication date and model download paragraph
releases.caveat: A selected family milestone, not a complete catalog of Llama generations.

releases.name: Qwen2-VL
releases.caveat: Blog date is August 29; repository News records August 30. The 72B weights followed the smaller models.

releases.name: Qwen2.5
releases.caveat: Language family announcement; separate from Qwen2.5-VL and later coder checkpoints.
releases.selection_basis: Widely used language family milestone that balances the previous emphasis on its vision variants.

releases.name: OpenAI o1
releases.locator: December 5 date and opening: Pro includes OpenAI o1; comparison with o1-preview
releases.caveat: Full o1 in ChatGPT, not the September 12 preview or December 17 API update.

releases.name: DeepSeek-V3
releases.caveat: API launch date, not the December 27 technical preprint.

releases.name: DeepSeek-R1
releases.caveat: Initial R1 launch, not the later R1-0528 update.

releases.name: Gemma 3
releases.locator: March 12 date, opening release statement and vision support footnote
releases.caveat: The 4B, 12B and 27B models support vision; the 1B variant is not a VLM.
releases.selection_basis: Representative compact multimodal family with documented distribution and ecosystem use.

releases.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
releases.locator: Publication date and first experimental release
releases.caveat: Experimental Pro release, not the later general availability date.

releases.name: Qwen3
releases.caveat: Official article date; not the later Qwen3-VL release.
releases.selection_basis: Representative language and thinking milestone in an established family.

releases.name: Claude 4
releases.caveat: Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 family announcement.

releases.name: Grok 4
releases.locator: July 9 header and opening availability statement
releases.caveat: Historical xAI release; current site branding changed. No world-best claim is repeated.
releases.selection_basis: Recognizable major proprietary family; adds missing coverage without every Grok generation.

releases.name: Kimi K2
releases.locator: Kimi K2 entry dated 2025-07-11, linked announcement
releases.caveat: Initial K2, not the September 0905 update or November Thinking release.
releases.selection_basis: Representative agentic MoE model preceding the already listed K3.

releases.name: GLM-4.5
releases.locator: News provided by Z.ai, July 28 date and opening release statement
releases.caveat: First party press release distributed through PRNewswire, not an independent performance assessment.
releases.selection_basis: Selected later GLM family milestone; no promotional ranking is repeated.

releases.name: GPT-5
releases.locator: Publication date and unified system introduction
releases.caveat: Product routing and model family are not a fully disclosed block architecture.

releases.name: Qwen3-VL
releases.caveat: First 235B-A22B release; smaller family members arrived later.

releases.name: Qwen3.5
releases.caveat: First 397B-A17B release; the repository was later renamed Qwen3.8 and retains the historical release log.

releases.name: GLM-5
releases.caveat: Paper date, not the earlier model launch or subsequent GLM-5.x variants.
releases.selection_basis: Representative 2026 paper from an established family, not a claim that this is its newest checkpoint.

releases.name: Claude Mythos Preview
releases.locator: Project Glasswing launch, April 7, 2026; early access participants
releases.caveat: Representative first Mythos release; restricted early access, not general availability or later Mythos 5 / 5.1.

releases.name: DeepSeek-V4
releases.caveat: V4 family API availability; later Flash and Pro GA updates are separate events.

releases.name: Kimi K3
releases.caveat: Weights and technical report date, not the earlier model announcement. Source title translated from Chinese.

releases.name: Qwen3.8
releases.caveat: First 2.4T-A95B release; 27B followed on August 14.

releases.name: Claude Fable 5.1
releases.caveat: Release date, not the August 31 Covered Model designation; distinct access rules from Mythos 5.1.

releases.name: GPT-6 Astra
releases.caveat: Initial rollout; do not equate this with unrestricted availability or the October ChatGPT expansion.

releases.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
releases.locator: September 10, 2026 header; live on DeepSeek API statement
releases.caveat: API availability event; no assertion of public weights release.

releases.name: Claude Opus 5.5
releases.caveat: Selected Opus launch; subsequent Sonnet and Haiku launches are not separate entries here.

releases.name: Gemini 4 Argon
releases.locator: Publication date and opening rollout paragraph
